projectDescription: A hyper-optimized Rust framework for building native Solana smart contracts with three execution modes: Standard (Borsh), Optimized (Zero-Copy), and Pinocchio (no_std, maximum performance).
keyFeatures: Three execution modes: Standard (Borsh), Optimized (Zero-Copy), and Pinocchio (no_std)
Procedural macros (#[naclac_program], #[component], #[instruction], #[event]) that generate boilerplate-free Solana programs
#[derive(Accounts)] and #[derive(AccountsLoader)] for automatic account validation and hydration
Automatic IDL generation and TypeScript SDK client generation from program source
Cross-Program Invocation (CPI) support with type-safe naclac-interface helpers
nacvm version manager for installing and switching between Naclac CLI versions
naclac doctor command for environment validation
SPL Token, Token-2022, and Associated Token Account support across all execution modes
Stack-allocated zero-copy PDA seed management for Pinocchio no_std programs
publicApiSurface: #[naclac_program] — program entry point macro, generates instruction dispatcher
#[naclac_program(zero_copy)] — zero-copy variant of the program entry point macro
#[component] / #[component(zero_copy)] — on-chain data struct macro
#[instruction] / #[instruction(zero_copy)] — instruction handler function macro
#[event] / #[event(zero_copy)] — on-chain event emitter macro
#[error_code] — custom program error enum macro
#[derive(Accounts)] — account validation and deserialization derive macro
#[derive(AccountsLoader)] — zero-copy account loader derive macro
#[naclac_interface] — CPI interface declaration macro
declare_id!(pubkey) — program ID declaration macro
emit!(EventStruct { ... }) — event emission macro
require!(condition, ErrorVariant) — assertion macro
Context<T> — instruction context type wrapping validated accounts and bumps
CpiContext — context for cross-program invocations
Signer<'info> — account wrapper enforcing signer privilege
Program<'info, T> — account wrapper for program accounts
AccountLoader<'info, T> — zero-copy account wrapper
Account<'info, T> — Borsh-deserialized account wrapper
Interface<'info, T> — account wrapper for token interface programs
Span<'info, T> / ZcVec<'info, T> — zero-copy non-allocating slice type
ZcString<'info> — zero-copy non-allocating string type
naclac init <name> [--mode pinocchio|standard|optimized] — scaffold new workspace
naclac add <name> [--mode] — add program to existing workspace
naclac build [program_id] [--features] — compile SBF binary and generate IDL
naclac generate [program_id] — generate TypeScript SDK from IDL
naclac deploy [program_id] — deploy programs to configured cluster
naclac test [file] [--all] — run TypeScript test suite
naclac upgrade [program_id] — upgrade deployed program
naclac verify [program_id] — verify on-chain determinism
naclac idl init [program_id] — initialize on-chain IDL
naclac account <address> — fetch and deserialize on-chain account
naclac logs [program_id] — tail cluster logs
naclac expand [program_id] — expand macros via cargo-expand
naclac profile [file] — profile compute unit usage
naclac clean [--hard] — clean workspace build artifacts
naclac airdrop [amount] — airdrop SOL to configured wallet
naclac doctor — check environment dependencies
nacvm install <version> — install a specific Naclac version
nacvm use <version> — switch active Naclac version
nacvm uninstall <version> — remove installed version
nacvm list — list all installed versions
